overview: Created by Indigenous director Piratá Waurá with producers Studio Kwo XR, Kamukuwaká takes us deep into the Amazon to the struggle of the Wauja people. Stewards of Brazil's first demarcated indigenous territory, they defend their homeland against farmers, loggers, wildfires and climate change. Drawing on ancient myths and their hyperconnected youth, the Wauja stand as a beacon of resilience. Through intimate 360° filming and 3D scanned environments, Piratá brings his people's wisdom in their Arawak language to global audiences, so we may reconnect to Nature as we face an uncertain future.
title: Kamukuwaká - The Call of the Forest

data.overview: A nova experiência em realidade virtual, dirigida por Piratá Waurá, é uma convocação da sabedoria ancestral para imaginarmos futuros possíveis frente à crise climática.

data.overview: 由瓦烏拉（Wauja）族導演 Piratá Waurá 執導，Studio Kwo XR 製作，《Kamukuwaká》帶領觀眾深入亞馬遜雨林，走進瓦烏拉族守護家園的真實處境。身處巴西首個劃設完成的原住民族保留地，他們長年面對農業開墾、非法伐木、野火與氣候變遷等威脅，仍持續守護世代相傳的土地。作品結合親密的 360 度實景拍攝與 3D 掃描重建，交織族群神話、青年世代與當代生活，並以阿拉瓦克語（Arawak）訴說來自部落的智慧，引領觀眾重新思索人與自然的連結，以及共同面對未來的可能。
data.title: 亞馬遜聖洞的秘密
